PaperQA Implementation and Parameters All reported figures and data in this work were built on the open source PaperQA package, available on GitHub at paperqa. While the core PaperQA repository provides the basic algorithms used, it does not include the Grobid parsing code, access to non-local full-text literature searches, or the citation traversal tool. The open source version of PaperQA utilizes LangChain 1 for its agentic and state update operations. The full configuration objects for all experiments run in this paper are included for further customization.
